verdict.rationale: Superhuman supports natural-language operation via Ask AI queries, plain-language personalization instructions, AI-prompt-based Auto Labels, and full MCP integration letting users drive inbox/calendar actions (summarize, draft, send, schedule) via Claude/ChatGPT with a single prompt. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of natural-language command accuracy and no first-party demo of complex multi-step NL commands beyond simple prompts.
